name: Bill split (even or by item)
use_when: one person paid and the group pays them back
'who owes who', 'split the bill', 'venmo me', 'how much do I owe'
an amount or items with prices are in the chat
dont_use_when: many tangled debts between many payers (adapt or build new)
only some of the chat share the bill and the rest should never be listed (everyone in the chat is on an even bill and can opt out)
guarantees: all money is integer cents; shares add up to the bill exactly
even shares differ by at most one cent
the payer is always marked paid; people who paid back owe something
an even bill covers everyone in the chat now, so a late joiner owes a share; only the payer changes the total, and not after someone paid back

title.description: What the bill is for, e.g. 'Dinner at Nopa'

payer.description: Name of the person who paid, exactly as in the members list, or empty

mode.description: even: one total split evenly; items: each item split across who had it

totalCents.description: Even mode: the total in cents ($184.50 is 18450), 0 if unknown

items.description: Items mode: items with prices from the chat; empty for even
